==Description==
'''PVP_5''' was a test [[Maps|map]] for [[PVP Test]].

==Design & Path==
'''PVP_5''' was a map split into two parts. These parts were identical, except one was colored red while the other was blue, and the sides were flipped. It was a basic baseplate with multiple cliffs on it, though none of them actually counted as cliff spots. There was a large brick located in the middle of the map, which acted as a cliff.

The path starts and ends at one side of the map. The path itself resembles a wrench or a heart.

==Interactive Map==
{{Map:PVPVar3}}

==Strategy==
*Towers should be placed around the top curve of the map, to ensure the path per range space is maximized, especially towers like the [[Golden Minigunner]] and [[Accelerator]].
**Towers like [[Sledger]], [[Brawler]], [[Warden]] and [[Gladiator]] should be placed on the corners of the path.
*Due to the centralized nature of this map, most towers should be placed around the middle, especially [[DJ Booth]].
*The cliff spot on the center of the map should be the one used for all cliff towers, as the other cliff spots remain too distant from appropriate ground spots to be reliable.

==Trivia==
*The intermission lobby lists SorenDerg as one of the creators. However, they were not actually involved in creating this map and have not even been active in the Tower Defense Simulator community since early 2023.
